about_the_game:
"Time Legend" is a fun and creative casual game that focuses on workplace life and creates a variety of distinctive game modes.

In the "Employee Mode", you will transform into a workplace worker. You have to deal with piles of work tasks while cleverly avoiding the boss's sudden "inspection", experiencing the daily life of workers struggling between work and slacking off.

"Boss Mode" allows you to switch roles and become a boss who controls the overall situation. You can manage employees and assign tasks, feeling the taste of a "leader" who makes plans strategically.

"Involution Mode" will bring you into a fierce workplace competition atmosphere, competing with other "colleagues" to see who can stand out in the competition.

"Thriller Mode" adds exciting elements, making your heart race as you handle workplace affairs in special situations.

"Love Rush" incorporates elements of love, allowing you to start a romantic journey in a busy workplace.

"Different Dimension Space" takes you into a fantasy parallel world of the workplace, experiencing different work and adventures.

"Win Step by Step" requires you to carefully plan every step and move forward steadily on the career path towards your goals.

The game also has systems such as "Skins", "Talent Pool", and "Store". You can unlock different character appearances, recruit various "talents" for assistance, and obtain various props in the store to make the gaming experience more diverse. Come to "Time Legend" and start your unique workplace gaming journey!
